# Nykøbing F. Pædiatri

Nykøbing F. Pædiatri is a pediatric department within the [[odense-university-hospital|SUH (Syddansk Universitetshospital)]] hospital system that participates in the [[danibd|DANIBD register]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The department is evaluated on its compliance with standardized diagnostic indicators for children and adolescents newly diagnosed with IBD.

According to the 2024 DANIBD audit results, Nykøbing F. Pædiatri achieved 67 % compliance with indicator 1b, which measures complete diagnostic workup of IBD in children and young people[^src1]. Complete diagnostic workup under this indicator requires gastroskopi (upper endoscopy), koloskopi (colonoscopy), and either MR-scanning or kapselendoskopi (video capsule endoscopy). This performance reflects broader variation across Danish pediatric departments; nationally, only 69 % of patients meet the target for indicator 1b, compared to 79 % for indicator 1a (adult colonoscopy screening)[^src2].

The DANIBD register monitors diagnostic procedures across all Danish public hospitals as part of quality assurance for IBD patient care. Indicator 1b is a particular focus because complete diagnostic imaging in children and adolescents establishes disease extent and guides long-term treatment strategy. The register's data collection encompasses patients with at least two hospital contacts for Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, short bowel syndrome, or primary sclerosing cholangitis, with estimated database coverage exceeding 90 %[^src3].
